decisions.reason: Having remained in the portfolio several years after launch, this bleaching tray line likely performs at least around aspiration levels and still fits the firm's dental materials and laboratory workflow strengths, so we would keep it.

The PETG thermoforming blank is closely tied to the firm's established production and materials capabilities, and its continued presence suggests acceptable outcomes relative to aspirations, making retention more likely than exit.

The custom earmold line leverages core custom-manufacturing skills, existing hearing-care channels, and international distribution, so after several years on the market it would normally be kept as a satisfactory strategic fit.

Although custom hearing protection earmolds remain the more niche line and thus face a somewhat higher withdrawal risk, they still reuse the firm's earmold capabilities and likely justify continued market presence unless performance clearly falls below aspirations.
